units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java reads and writes PDF documents. It creates and manipulates PDF content such as pages, text fragments, widget annotations, radio button fields, and cell structures. It supports setting annotation characteristics including border color, background color, and border style. It saves documents to the PDF format.
It creates and edits PDF documents by adding pages, inserting text fragments, and placing interactive widgets such as radio button options with customizable borders and backgrounds.

It handles interactive form fields including radio button options with named selections, widget annotations with appearance characteristics like border color and background fill, and border styles such as dashed lines.
It secures documents using standard security handlers with user and owner passwords.
It converts documents to PDF from HTML, DOCX, XLSX, and Markdown using dedicated load options, and exports PDF back to HTML, DOCX, XLSX, and Markdown via save options.
It extracts and replaces text across a document using absorber classes and supports right-to-left and Arabic glyph shaping through dedicated shaper components.
It performs page operations such as splitting, merging, inserting, extracting, and reordering using a file editor, and renders pages to raster formats including multi-page TIFF.
This example creates a new PDF document, adds a page, and inserts a widget annotation with a red border, then prints the RGB values of the border color to the console.
More real, verified snippets are collected below — mixing plain text with an interactive form field inside the same table cell.
Add a text fragment and a radio button option to a table cell.
Create a PDF with a text fragment and save it to a file.
Append multiple radio button options to a cell in insertion order.
Set and read the background color of a widget annotation.
Set and inspect the border style of a radio button option field.

The central class is Document, whose pages are reached through PageCollection and Page, each backed by a Resources dictionary. Document-level convenience operations are exposed through the facades — PdfFileEditor, PdfContentEditor, PdfBookmarkEditor, PdfExtractor, PdfConverter, and PdfFileSignature, among others. The public API surface spans 1181 public types across the module-grouped tables below.
The org namespace serves as the top-level package grouping for the Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java module.
The org.aspose namespace contains core classes such as Document, Page, PageCollection, and Resources that form the foundation of the PDF processing API.
The org.aspose.pdf namespace provides the complete set of classes and interfaces for working with PDF documents, including content creation, editing, extraction, and conversion operations.
It adds broader format conversion (including OCR and non-PDF output formats), full feature completeness, and commercial support.
LoadFormat enum lists the DocX, HTML, Markdown, PDF and Xlsx file formats.
DoWhileStmt class holds a JavaScript do-while loop with a test condition, a body statement, and an at method that sets the source position and returns this for chaining.

XfaPacket class represents an XFA packet with a constructor that creates a packet, a dirty property, a document property, and methods to get the document, name, source bytes, check for source bytes, and determine if it is dirty, as well as a markDirty method that marks this packet as modified so write-back re-serializes it.
